model_annotation: This plot illustrates the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany, categorized by age, from 2010 to 2020. The x-axis represents age in years, displayed on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70 with tick labels spaced every 5 years. The y-axis represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany, ranging from 0% to 85% with tick labels spaced every 10%. A black solid line represents the percentage of immigrants without migration background who have settled in Germany, starting at approximately 75% at age 20 and decreasing to approximately 30% at age 70. A light gray dashed line represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany up to 2009, beginning at approximately 60% at age 20 and decreasing to approximately 30% at age 70. A blue dotted line represents the percentage of immigrants in Germany born abroad who have settled in Germany starting from 2010, beginning at approximately 10% at age 20 and decreasing to approximately 5% at age 70.
